name: LPV Voxelization Sampling
aliases: Area Lights Voxelization for Light Propagation Volumes
definition: A method to sample area light source meshes for Light Propagation Volumes (LPV) by voxelizing the light triangles into the LPV grid, creating Virtual Point Lights (VPLs) at intersection areas to simulate direct illumination more efficiently than dense sampling.
summary: LPV Voxelization Sampling improves direct illumination in Light Propagation Volumes by generating one Virtual Point Light per intersecting cell, ensuring optimal coverage while reducing processing overhead.
